Fellows are welcome and encouraged to take part in activities offered by theInstitute and by the International Max Planck Research School “Knowledge and ItsResources” that take place on our campus.Candidates are expected to have already completed the relevant research for their thesis andbe in a position to devote six months to writing and preparing an article in English forjournal publication. Fellows must remain enrolled in their home institution’s doctoralprogram through the end of the advertised fellowship period.Fellowships are endowed with a monthly stipend according to the guidelines of the MaxPlanck Society (https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-fellowship).Applicants should submit the following materials in English through our online applicationportal:1. Cover letter explaining how the applicant’s proposed research fits the researchthemes of one specific department1. Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remainenrolled in an accredited graduate program (PhD) through the end of thefellowship1. 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant2. Curriculum vitae (preferably without a photograph) including any publications ifapplicable1. Title, abstract, and outline of article to be completed during the fellowship(maximum 750 words)1. English-language writing sample (maximum 8000 words including notes andbibliography) written by the applicant7. A letter of recommendation from one supervisorThis program is intended to support scholars who wish to improve their academic English.We encourage you to write your application without the use of AI.The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science encourages applications from qualifiedindividuals who belong to groups that are often underrepresented in the workplace due to age,disability, ethnicity, family status, gender, nationality, race, sex, sexual orientation,socioeconomic background, or religion.Please note that only electronic submissions will be accepted. Applications must beuploaded to the following link on or before 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET):https://recruitment.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/position/36470793Finalists may expect a decision by 1 April 2027.Descriptions of the research projects undertaken by the departments can be found here:Artifacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK):https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/artifacts-action-knowledgeKnowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL):https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/knowledge-systems-collective-lifeFor further information, please consult the Frequently Asked Questions at the program’swebsite: https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-fellowship.For all other questions, contact the Publications Manager for this program, LindyDivarci                 divarci@mpiwg-berlin.mpg.deMax Planck Institute for the History of ScienceBoltzmannstr. 22, 14195 BerlinGermany
